labels.labeller: The AI assistant working for the authors (Claude), provisional, pending author review
labels.independence: Not independent. The labeller wrote the cases and the checker prompt, and saw the per-case checker allow/block summary before labelling. The checker model (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) is a different model family from the labeller and the writer (Llama 3.3 70B).
labels.rubric: Judge each answer against its records and the policy pages only. supported: every claim agrees with the evidence, in the right role. complete: it gives what was asked that the evidence contains, or says it is not there. Do not look at checker verdicts while labelling.
